OUR MATERIALS

Five grades, one standard.

From coarse VSI aggregate to fine plastering sand — each material is sourced, crushed or washed to a consistent spec before it leaves our yard.

Aggregate
01 — VSI AGGREGATE

Strong, durable, high quality

Crushed using Vertical Shaft Impactor technology for a cubical, uniform shape that packs tighter and bonds better in concrete. Available in 20mm, 10mm and 6mm.

  • 20mm — ideal for strong construction
  • 10mm — best for concrete & plaster
  • 6mm — perfect for fine finish
  • Consistent shape, low wastage
Sand
02 — P-SAND

Clean, well-graded, plaster-ready

Manufactured sand with low silt content and a uniform grain size — built for smooth plastering and stronger masonry bonding.

  • Low silt content for better bonding
  • Well graded for smooth plastering
  • Superior, long-lasting finish
  • Trusted for every construction project
Sand
03 — RIVER CRUSH SAND

Crushed from river pebble, washed clean

Made by crushing naturally hard river pebbles with VSI technology, then washing out dust and silt. Graded 0mm–4.75mm for RCC work, slab casting and pavers.

  • Low dust & silt content
  • Uniform particle size for smooth finishing
  • High strength, natural & durable
  • RCC, columns, beams, footings, pavers
Pebble
04 — NATURAL RIVER PEBBLE

100% natural, sourced from rivers

Naturally rounded pebbles sourced directly from riverbeds — weather-resistant and long-lasting, built for landslide protection and garden landscaping.

  • 100% natural & eco-friendly
  • Landslide protection & garden use
  • Weather resistant, low maintenance
  • High strength, long lasting
Sand
05 — YERGAHTI SAND

The all-rounder for bandkam & slab work

A local favourite for masonry (bandkam) and slab work, with a smooth finish for plastering and strong, long-lasting bonding.

  • Ideal for slab work
  • Best for bandkam / masonry work
  • Smooth finish for plastering
  • Clean, well-graded stock
